Amazon EKS Capabilities now supports Argo CD Notifications
changes.detail: The Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) Capability for Argo CD now supports Argo CD Notifications, providing notifications when your applications sync, fail, or change health. You define triggers and message templates in your cluster and subscribe individual Applications with an annotation, the same way you do in upstream Argo CD. With this launch, you can deliver notifications to 16 notification services, including Slack, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Amazon SQS, and Amazon EventBridge.
